name: PB-22
summary: PB-22 is a designer drug offered by online vendors as a cannabimimetic agent, and detected being sold in synthetic cannabis products in Japan in 2013. PB-22 represents a structurally unique synthetic cannabinoid chemotype, since it contains an ester linker at the indole 3-position, rather than the precedented ketone of JWH-018 and its analogs, or the amide of APICA and its analogs.

pharmacology.text: PB-22 has an EC50 of 5.1 nM for human CB1 receptors, and 37 nM for human CB2 receptors.

uses.text: PB-22 (QUPIC, SGT-21 or 1-pentyl-1H-indole-3-carboxylic acid 8-quinolinyl ester) is a designer drug offered by online vendors as a cannabimimetic agent, and detected being sold in synthetic cannabis products in Japan in 2013.

summaryZh: PB-22是一種狡詐家藥物，化學式為C23H22N2O2，它在網絡上作為大麻模擬劑供應，並在2013年於日本的合成大麻產品被發現。PB-22在其吲哚環的3號位有酯基，可以被視作一類具有獨特結構的合成大麻素。它在2014年於紐西蘭、同年於美國管控。
